tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Antibacterial Activity of Designed Cyclic Peptides
footnotes: The minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) is the lowest concentration of the peptides that inhibited bacterial growth.
HC50 is the concentration of a peptide in μg/mL at which 50% hemolysis was observed.
The therapeutic index is calculated based on HC50/MIC against MRSA. The table presents the data of three independent experiments performed in triplicate.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Minimum Inhibitory Concentrations of 5a, 5b, 6a, and 6b against ESKAPE Pathogens
footnotes: The minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) is the lowest concentration of the peptides that inhibited bacterial growth.
Gentamicin-, streptomycin-, and vancomycin-resistant bacterial strain.
Penicillin-, clindamycin-, cotrimoxazole-, and erythromycin-resistant bacterial strain.
Carbapenem, New Delhi metallo-beta-lactamase (NDM-1)-positive resistant bacterial strain (CRE (NDM-1)).
Resistant to ceftazidime, gentamicin, ticarcillin, piperacillin, aztreonam, cefepime, ciprofloxacin, imipenem, and meropenem.
ND, not determined. The table presents the data of three independent experiments performed in triplicate.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Minimum Inhibitory Concentration of 5a against Additional ESKAPE Pathogens Including Clinical Isolates
footnotes: The minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) is the lowest concentration of the peptides that inhibited bacterial growth.
Carbapenem, New Delhi metallo-beta-lactamase (NDM-1)-positive resistant bacterial strain (CRE (NDM-1)).
Extended-spectrum β-lactamase (ESBL) (K. pneumoniae ATCC 700603 produces SHV-18).

tables.label: Table 4
tables.caption: Minimum Bactericidal Concentrations (MBC) of Cyclic Peptides 5a, 5b, 6a, and 6b
footnotes: The minimum bactericidal concentration (MBC) is the lowest concentration of the peptides that completely kill the bacteria.
ND = not determined. The table presents the data of three independent experiments performed in triplicate.

tables.label: Table 5
tables.caption: The Synergistic Effect of the Peptide 5a/Antibiotic Combination
footnotes: FIC of the peptide in combination is 0.25 (peptide concentration equivalent to one-fourth of its MIC).
FIC of the peptide in combination is 0.5 (peptide concentration equivalent to one-half of its MIC); all experiments were performed in triplicate.

tables.caption: The Synergistic Effect of the Peptide 6a/Antibiotic Combination
footnotes: FIC of the peptide in combination is 0.25 (peptide concentration equivalent to one-fourth of its MIC).
